decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0004-lfo-rnd, version 1.2 (core-ar2 0.4 page tables), for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's 31 OS 1.74 port sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release; its ten bytes sites are declared kind data. No stock bytes are retained.
mod.json's storage field (lfo_rnd_cfg, scope sound, 16 bits) became build.json's storage, and its three contribute entries (core_pages, core_params, core_view_pages) build.json's contribute.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: Modwerk's base is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc and shared/shared.s keep their paths relative to the source, so the .include lines in src/lfo-rnd.s are unchanged.
upstream/README.md is lfo-rnd/README.md at e029f75 with the stock values of its ten `bytes` rows replaced by (stock), so no stock bytes are kept; the new values and everything else are unchanged.
src/lfo-rnd.s is lfo-rnd/os1.74/lfo-rnd.s at e029f75 with six comments reworded so that none quotes a stock instruction (the author's OK, 2026-11-08); the code and its assembled bytes are unchanged.
